title: Eval Contamination x Control-Benchmark Trust: Compounding Overconfidence in Safety Cases

original_idea.body: Probe an open model for memorization of public control/attack tasks and compare evaded-detection rate on likely-memorized vs paraphrased-novel variants, quantifying contamination-driven over-certification.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Contamination over-certifying control evals undermines the safety cases they support.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Memorization probing plus memorized-vs-paraphrased comparison; accessible methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reuses open tooling, public benchmarks, lab-independent integrity check.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference plus perplexity probing on open models, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Contamination checks exist; applied to control benchmarks may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Contamination methods exist; control-benchmark application may be open.
